# ray-vfx: twenty anime-reacting Web Components

One file per component, zero dependencies, MIT. Each file self-registers its element as a classic script; it carries its own copy of the core. The first loaded file sets window.RayFX; one fixed canvas over the page draws every effect. No CSS import, no bundler.

## Components

1. rv-button: primary squashes and inverts on release, a spiky burst, four puffs, ドン!; secondary is a small squash with three wedges. done(hold) lands a check and a glint. a: variant(primary|secondary), fx, disabled, loading. m: done(), fail().
2. rv-toggle: a 43-frame drawn flip, the knob smears and slams with a splash; frames are inside the file. a: checked, label, disabled, name, value. p: checked. e: change.
3. rv-slider: the thumb stretches into a teardrop and lags on a spring; drag fast and cumulus rolls up. a: min, max, step, value, label, unit, name, disabled. p: value. m: set(v). e: input, change.
4. rv-checkbox: two crescents swing, crystals fly, ズザッ. a: checked, indeterminate, disabled, name, value. p: checked. e: change.
5. rv-radio: the dot springs in with a fan of wedges and a hollow ポン. a: name, value, label, disabled. children: <option>. p: value. e: change.
6. rv-input: every key kicks up dust where the caret is. a: label, placeholder, name, value, type, disabled, required, maxlength. p: value. m: focus(), blur(), clear(). e: input, change.
7. rv-tabs: the raised tab slides and lands with wedges and a puff; you render the panels. a: value, label, disabled. children: <option>. e: change.
8. rv-progress: a storm cloud rides the leading edge; a burst and a check at the end. a: label, value(0..1), indeterminate. m: set(n), reset(). e: ray:done.
9. rv-rating: stars pop in sequence; a full score gets a confetti burst. a: label, value, max, readonly, name. p: value. e: change.
10. rv-toast: streaks in as a smear, lands in dust, dissolves. a: position, duration. m: show(msg), success(), error(), info(). e: ray:show, ray:hide.
11. rv-tooltip: springs out like a speech bubble with puffs and カチッ. a: text, placement, delay. slot: trigger. e: ray:open, ray:close.
12. rv-select: unfolds like a cabinet menu, scanline sweep, keyboard typeahead. a: label, name, value, disabled. children: <option>. p: value. e: change.
13. rv-textarea: pixel dust where the caret is; auto-grow with the auto-grow attribute. a: label, rows, auto-grow, placeholder, name. p: value. m: focus(), blur(), clear(). e: input, change.
14. rv-alert: cuts in with a slash across the banner; error banners get a BAM!. a: variant(info|success|warning|error), title, dismissible. m: show(), hide(). e: ray:open, ray:dismiss.
15. rv-card: a paper card with pointer-tracked tilt, a hover glint and a puff on click. a: title, subtitle, interactive. slots: default, header, footer.
16. rv-avatar: a ringed avatar with a status LED and initials fallback. a: src, alt, initials, size(sm|md|lg), status(online|offline|busy|away).
17. rv-badge: a small paper status chip. a: variant(ink|pink|violet|lime|amber), size. m: pulse().
18. rv-modal: zooms in on a spring, PAAN!, lands in dust; focus trap, Escape and backdrop close. a: title, size(sm|md|lg), closable. m: show(), hide(), toggle(). slots: default, actions. e: ray:open, ray:close.
19. rv-pagination: the active chip springs, and a smoke ring drifts off it; the last page gets a MAX. a: total, per-page, page, sibling-count, disabled. p: page. e: change.
20. rv-spinner: an ink dot orbits; determinate when value is set; a glint at 100%. a: variant(orbit|pulse|bars), size(sm|md|lg), value, label. m: set(v).

## Core API (window.RayFX)

- The drawn effects: puff, burst, shards, ring, splash, slash, lines, ticks, donut, wob, kira, sfx (six traced manga words: don, gogo, kachi, pon, shu, zuza), sfxText (arbitrary two-tone lettering).
- Spring: a damped harmonic oscillator with .to(v), .set(v), .stop(), .settled.
- The Base class: shadow DOM, attribute/property reflection, ElementInternals for forms, this.spring(), this.fx(name, opts), this.emit(name, detail), cleanup in disconnectedCallback.
- Reduced motion is honored live; springs snap to their target and effects are skipped.
- Theming only through --rv-* CSS variables, read with getComputedStyle.
- Events are prefixed ray:; native events (click, change, input) are not.
